设计意图： Combines the candlestick shape anomaly (lower shadow proportion z-score) from bar_shape_001 with the volume confirmation (ratio to 20-day average volume) from apvc_gen0_1. The multiplication amplifies shape signals when volume is elevated, filtering out low-conviction noise. The z-score normalization ensures stationarity and rank stability, while volume ratio improves IC and MI by emphasizing info

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(z-score(lower_shadow / (lower+upper), 20) * (volume / volume_ma20))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(subtract(AdjOpen, AdjLow), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-10)), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjOpen, AdjLow), add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-10))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjOpen, AdjLow)
  4. 4. add —— 加法
    add(subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow), 1e-10)
  5. 5. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjHigh, AdjLow)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjHigh后复权最高复权后的当日最高价
AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价
AdjOpen后复权开盘复权后的开盘价
Volume成交量当日成交量（股数），反映参与度

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 lower：[open, close.min(axis=1) - low
  2. 计算 upper：high - [open, close.max(axis=1)
  3. 计算 total：lower + upper
  4. 计算 shadow_ratio：lower / (total + 1e-8)
  5. 计算 mean：shadow_ratio.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  6. 计算 std：shadow_ratio.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std()
  7. 计算 shadow_z：(shadow_ratio - mean) / (std + 1e-8)
  8. 计算 volume_ma20：volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=1).mean()
  9. 计算 volume_ratio：volume / (volume_ma20 + 1e-8)
  10. 计算 factor：shadow_z * volume_ratio
  11. 计算 factor：factor.clip(-5, 5)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_shadow_volume_confirmed(df): df_copy = df.copy() lower = df_copy[["str">'open', "str">'close']].min(axis=1) - df_copy["str">'low'] upper = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy[["str">'open', "str">'close']].max(axis=1) total = lower + upper shadow_ratio = lower / (total + 1e-8) mean = shadow_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() std = shadow_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std() shadow_z = (shadow_ratio - mean) / (std + 1e-8) volume_ma20 = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=1).mean() volume_ratio = df_copy["str">'volume'] / (volume_ma20 + 1e-8) factor = shadow_z * volume_ratio factor = factor.clip(-5, 5).fillna(0) factor.name = "str">'factor_shadow_volume_confirmed' "kw">class="kw">return factor
